system.name: brAInwav Design System
system.reference: Editorial personal identity paired with a dark technical proof surface

positioning.developer_benefit: Help developers adopt emerging AI tools with confidence.
positioning.affiliation_boundary: OpenAI and Tessl are relevant audiences and career bridges, not affiliations or the headline identity.

site_roles.portfolio: Single public front door for Jamie's personal narrative, concise case studies, speaking, contact routes, and bounded technical proof.
site_roles.brAInwav: Jamie's identity and shared presentation system for the work, turning human perspective, AI tools, and technical exploration into public products, writing, and evidence surfaces.

site_handoffs.technical_depth: Route technical depth to public ChatGPT Sites, GitBooks, GitHub repositories, READMEs, documentation, diagrams, tests, implementation excerpts, and bounded evidence receipts when each project is ready.
site_handoffs.claim_boundary: Evidence before claims; current source identity and freshness remain visible.

identity.canonical_origin: brAInwav brings together the human perspective, AI tools, and technical wave I continue to explore and build with.

origin_parts.brain: The human perspective that shapes how Jamie works.
origin_parts.AI: The AI tools that helped Jamie.
origin_parts.wav: The technical wave Jamie continues to explore and build with.

wordmark.construction: one continuous word on one baseline with AI at the same size and weight

neuron.construction: simplified asymmetric recognisably neuronal form with one signal or wave path

product_identity.identity_source: product name and custom functional mark, never a unique dominant colour
product_identity.interface_icons: Use one coherent library or platform-native icon family for standard interface actions.
product_identity.stock_icon_boundary: An unmodified stock library icon must not become a product logo.

product_cover.renderer: structured manifest rendered with HTML, CSS, and SVG
product_cover.imagegen_boundary: Image generation is exploratory or decorative only and must not generate final typography, product UI, product logos, evidence, provenance, or status.
product_cover.reflow_rule: Square and portrait formats stack editorial above technical proof; they are not automatic crops of the landscape master.

manifest_field_contracts.support: Optional short explanation; omit before overflowing.
manifest_field_contracts.proof_object: Authentic capture, implementation excerpt, or system diagram.
manifest_field_contracts.proof_source_identity: Exact source revision, candidate fingerprint, artifact digest, capture URL and date, or equivalent proof binding.
manifest_field_contracts.design_system_source_commit: Exact source commit of the consumed canonical token contract.

maturity_levels.rule: Describe only behavior supported by current implementation or test evidence.
Describe only the bounded observed user task.
Describe only the evidenced adoption scope.

evidence.current_rule: Evidence is current only when bound to the exact source identity or a recent valid receipt.
evidence.mismatch_rule: Source mismatch automatically makes evidence stale.
evidence.headline_rule: Every headline public claim requires public-inspectable proof.
evidence.analytics_boundary: Traffic indicates interest only; it does not prove adoption or confidence.

role_boundary.jamie: Frames the problem, directs the work, makes product and taste decisions, inspects the result, validates the evidence, and owns the claims.
role_boundary.codex: Implements within Jamie's direction, proposes options, generates bounded artifacts, and supports inspection and validation.

primary_cta.rule: End with one primary call to action that helps the reader inspect evidence or provide public technical feedback.

channel_separation.public_technical_feedback: Attach public technical feedback to the artifact or evidence surface.
channel_separation.private_hiring_or_contact: Route private hiring or contact through an approved private contact surface.
channel_separation.rule: Keep public technical feedback separate from private hiring or contact routes.

skillsbar_flagship.core_sentence: A changed Skill candidate should not inherit proof that no longer belongs to it.
skillsbar_flagship.lead_decision: What can the Skill maintainer safely conclude about the current candidate, and what should they inspect next?
skillsbar_flagship.career_bridge: Reserve OpenAI and Tessl relevance for a short closing bridge.

fixtures: missing, stale, blocked, unverified, concept, and current states
narrow mobile, zoom, increased text, and font failure
one-colour, low-quality display, print, and colour-vision conditions
reduced motion, no JavaScript, slow images, and complete static fallback
stock icon used as product logo

color_rules: Blue represents current or verified technical evidence and navigation.
Orange represents AI in the brAInwav wordmark, inspection, attention, stale evidence, and required action.
Bright accents are for dark surfaces; ink variants are for text and icons on light surfaces.
Status colours never become product identity colours and never communicate state without a label or icon.
Products must not introduce a new dominant colour without a separate system decision.

families.sans: Geist, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

typography.delivery: Self-host the official variable font files in each product; do not rely on an operating-system font install.
rules: Use Newsreader only for page identity, case-study titles, editorial statements, and product-cover hooks.
Use Geist Semibold for product names and the brAInwav wordmark.
Use Geist for body copy, controls, navigation, product UI, and explanatory labels.
Use Geist Mono for evidence, commands, statuses, dates, measurements, and compact metadata.
Do not introduce a fourth typeface or set display copy in all capitals.

spacing.rule: Use the named roles first. Use primitive values only when no semantic role fits.

iconography.ui_source: Use one coherent outline family per product; prefer platform-native symbols in native controls.
iconography.brand_motif: The neuron and wave belong to brAInwav identity and editorial illustration, not routine interface controls or standard product-cover marks.
product_mark_rules: Use no more than two brand colours.
Keep a recognisable monochrome silhouette at 16px.
Do not bake product names or taglines into app icons.
Build app-store artwork on a 1024px master and small marks on a 64px master.

social_profile.banner_rule: The profile avatar is supplied by the platform and must never be baked into a banner export.

social_safe_rule: Keep all important identity content away from the lower-left avatar overlay area.
